item.title: Natsuiro Penguin
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Little Princess
  • 発売日: 2009-11-27
  • スコア: 6.94/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夏いろペンギン
  • 英語名: Natsuiro Penguin

あらすじ

Since his parents have gone abroad on business, he now lives at his cousin’s house in a town, where he used to live. He meets various childhood friends there. It’s busy, but he enjoys his school life. This is a love comedy adventure game taken place in a small town. Who will stay by his side in the end…?

item.title: Furufuru☆Full Moon
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Little Princess
  • 発売日: 2008-05-30
  • スコア: 6.62/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ふるふる☆フルムーン
  • 英語名: Furufuru☆Full Moon

别名

  • Le lapin est amoureux de la lune dans une saison pour grandir

あらすじ

This is a story taken place in a little bit different world. In this world, everyone has the other self called Halo. Halo is born from the holy stone, Mana, when they are born. Yuu’s parents passed away, so he now lives alone. One day, he receives a letter. It says, “We’ve got something important for you.” He follows the letter’s instructions and comes to a high school. What he faces there are his old friends and secret of his birth….
